messages:
Oliver Grant: heads-up from a docs review: the /v1/generate reference still documents `timeout` as a string query param and all examples show a single `generation` object. current service expects `timeout_ms` (integer) and returns `generations` (array). causing 400s when folks copy the curl.

Meera Shah: thanks Oliver. where is the spec file? can you paste a minimal repro?

Oliver Grant: openapi/specs/generate.yaml and docs/examples/generate_examples.md. repro: `curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hey"}'` -> 400 invalid type for timeout. server accepts `timeout_ms=5000` or header `X-Timeout-Ms: 5000`.

Yuki Tanaka: confirmed on staging. we intentionally changed the API name server-side to `timeout_ms` and removed loose string coercion. will need: (1) OpenAPI edit to replace the param with integer `timeout_ms`, (2) update examples (curl/python/js/go/rust) to use `timeout_ms` or header, (3) switch response examples to `generations` array, (4) add migration note and changelog.

Meera Shah: can you drop the exact YAML and JSON snippets to paste into the PR? also note any SDK naming conventions so we can update SDK docs.

Oliver Grant: YAML param to use:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    description: Timeout in milliseconds. Alternative: set header `X-Timeout-Ms`.
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
```
Response sample to use in docs (JSON):
```json
{
  "id": "req_zz123",
  "model": "rwd-13b",
  "generations": [
    {"text": "hi", "tokens": ["hi"], "metadata": {}}
  ],
  "perf": {"latency_ms": 33}
}
```
SDK naming note: JS uses `timeoutMs` (camelCase), Python uses `timeout_ms` kwarg, Go struct field `TimeoutMs`. Rust crate follows snake_case `timeout_ms`. Please add a one-line mapping table in the migration doc.

Yuki Tanaka: add an infra integration test that asserts `generations` is present in the response body to prevent doc/runtime drift. Also include both query param and header examples in the PR.

Meera Shah: i'll open the docs PR to change openapi/specs/generate.yaml, update examples under docs/examples/, add docs/migrations/2026-03-generate-timeoutms-and-response-array.md, and a line in docs/CHANGELOG.md. assigning reviewers @Oliver Grant @Yuki Tanaka.

release-bot: PR opened by Meera Shah: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/5142 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review)

Oliver Grant: thanks — i'll run a quick smoke against staging once merged and report any regressions. please tag me on the PR for review.

Meera Shah: will include a short migration snippet showing the old -> new examples and call out that clients sending `timeout` (string) will receive 400s; advise using `timeout_ms` or header. aiming to merge after two approvals and green CI. :thumbsup:
